subject: Quickbridge: weekly wins, capacity pinchpoints, and two asks for QBR
messages:
From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: cara@northstar.com, procurement@northstar.com
Date: 2027-04-02T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Quickbridge: weekly wins, capacity pinchpoints, and two asks for QBR

Morning all — quick exec snapshot for this week (short, actionable). Please read end-to-end; two asks flagged in bold.

TL;DR
- Wins: NorthStar pilot kickoff completed (stage 1), Optimize recommendations reduced expected token cost ~18% on embeddings test.
- Risks: upcoming trial spike next week may breach our Dedicated capacity SLOs without a short-term burst; some telemetry gaps on per-route caching.
- Asks: 1) Jonas — want sign-off on 48-hour burst budget; 2) Laura/Marissa — someone to own the single-slide QBR callout.

Details
1) Customer pilot (NorthStar Systems) — Positive start: first 3 integration tests passed, latency median 45ms for short chat flows. Cara is delighted with response quality but flagged a larger ingest window planned for April 11 that could double tokens. See attached draft of the QBR slide for the pilot.

2) Cost optimization — Optimize auto-suggested a new batching config for embeddings; in bench it showed ~18% unit cost reduction. Rolling this recommendation into staging tonight; should not impact user-facing latency.

3) Capacity pinchpoint — telemetry shows our west-coast Dedicated pool has ~15% spare capacity today but expected load (NorthStar trial + internal load tests) could require a temporary 48-hour burst (+2 nodes) to keep 99th percentile below our SLA. Without burst we may see throttling for non-critical routes.

4) Observability gap — per-route cache hit metrics are intermittent for a subgroup of routes (likely the new SDK header behavior). Engineering is triaging; this impacts our ability to confidently set rollout size for the Optimize change.

Asks (explicit)
- ACTION (Jonas): Please approve a 48-hour burst from Dedicated pool on Monday 2027-04-05 for NorthStar trial. Estimated cost: ~$4.2k. If no approval, we’ll fallback to traffic shaping and push some non-critical workloads to the EU region.
- ACTION (Laura or Marissa): Please volunteer to own the QBR single-slide narrative for the NorthStar pilot (5 bullets + one metrics chart). Draft attached. Need final by EOD Friday.

Attachments:
- QBR_slide_draft_v1.pdf (PDF, 1.8MB)
- capacity_runbook.xlsx (XLSX, 120KB)

Open questions for leadership:
- Do we prefer us to proceed with the burst (Jonas to approve) or implement region-based traffic shaping (slower but lower cost)?
- Who will present the NorthStar pilot narrative at the QBR if we push the deck?

Thanks — short and ready to expand in the ops huddle at 9:30.

— Olga
Olga Petrov
Director, Platform Ops
Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, cara@northstar.com
Date: 2027-04-02T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quickbridge: weekly wins, capacity pinchpoints, and two asks for QBR

Olga — thanks for the crisp update. I tentatively approve the 48-hour burst but want a short guardrail: cap additional spend at $5k and auto-shutdown if average 99p latency does not improve by at least 5% in the first 6 hours.

Please coordinate with ACME Cloud Sales (cc'd) on provisioning; they can stand up the extra nodes. Also ask Engineering to provide an adjusted traffic-shaping plan as a contingency (we should be ready to flip that switch).

Jonas
VP, Infrastructure
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: cara@northstar.com
Date: 2027-04-02T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quickbridge: weekly wins, capacity pinchpoints, and two asks for QBR

I’ll own the QBR pilot slide.
Plan: I’ll tighten the narrative to 4 bullets + one chart (latency by percentiles) and include the Optimize cost delta. Will circulate v2 by 3pm PT for quick review.

One ask from my side — can Eng produce a single “expected impact” sentence for the slide about the burst vs shaping? Prefer something measurable we can display.

Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@northstar.com, acme_sales@acme.com
Date: 2027-04-02T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quickbridge: weekly wins, capacity pinchpoints, and two asks for QBR

Thanks team — quick notes:
- Jonas: budget guardrail approved as proposed. Good call.
- ACME: please confirm provisioning ETA and share the instance sizing; we prefer smallest possible to meet the latency goal.
- Procurement (NorthStar): Cara, I’ll send a short note with the QBR one-pager and the expected timeline after Marissa finalizes the slide.

If all aligns, Olga — please proceed with burst prep (coordinate with ACME and Eng) and send me a brief standby note for the QBR deck by 5pm PT.

— Laura
Chief of Staff, Product & GTM
